reasons: Alcohol vending needs an age check, but retaining face and ID images of every buyer is over-collection; the escrow adds a honeypot and may need biometrics for anti-sharing.
context_purpose: Prevent sales of alcohol to minors at an unattended machine.

norm_violation_today.reason: Keeping a face and ID log of every beer buyer goes well beyond the one-bit age check the context needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A bare over-18 proof cannot stop borrowed credentials or trace an abuser without liveness/device binding or an escrow.

transmission_check.reason: Operators likely need to show they prevented minor sales, but I cannot say whether a regulator requires retained ID images.

reasons: Niche purchase kin check is a rare, one-off moment; operator collects by habit and the proof is feasible but kin priority is complex and the incentive is weak.
context_purpose: Confirm the buyer is entitled to contract for the deceased's remains before selling a niche.

norm_violation_today.reason: A full ID scan and household transcript with relatives' details exceeds a single kin-eligibility fact, and copies are shared with sales agents.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little beyond the operator's dispute evidence that the check was done; a signed receipt could cover it.

transmission_check.reason: Unclear whether any rule on columbarium operators requires retained identity copies.

reasons: Party membership is sensitive political data, so a signed sheet is a real harm, but the stakes are small, the chapter knows its members, and the benefit is voluntary.
context_purpose: Give registered members a discount once per period and prevent repeat claims.

norm_violation_today.reason: A paper sheet linking names and ID numbers to party membership persists beyond the discount check.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing material; membership plus once-per-period nullifier covers the stated need.

transmission_check.reason: The person volunteers data for a discount and no legal duty requires the signed sheet.

reasons: Library card enrolment collects guardian and child details joined with borrowing history; separation is plausible but the library can still link at enrolment and retention is policy-driven.
context_purpose: Issue a children's library card to an eligible guardian and enrolled child and track loans.

norm_violation_today.reason: Libraries legitimately need guardian contact for liability, but joining national ID to full loan history is more than borrowing needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Overdue recovery and liability for lost books need a way to reach the guardian.

transmission_check.reason: Public library enrolment rules may require identifiable records; I cannot confirm.

reasons: Strong over-collection of a household register for a simple status predicate, but is a close variant of the known scholarship application case, and tribe-specific awards and audit retention complicate it.
context_purpose: Verify indigenous status and enrolment to award a scholarship.

norm_violation_today.reason: A full register copy exposes family members, address and tribe when only status and enrolment are needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Audit evidence of the original document, and tribe-specific awards need a selective tribe reveal.

transmission_check.reason: Public-funded audit rules may require retained supporting documents; I cannot confirm what is mandated.

reasons: Anonymous weighted voting is a real privacy gain, but it needs a full voting system and may conflict with record requirements for resolutions; trust moves to the committee issuing credentials.
context_purpose: Count eligible, weighted, one-per-unit votes on a building repair fund fairly and verifiably.

norm_violation_today.reason: A vendor and committee chair seeing who voted how breaks ballot-secrecy norms for a collective vote.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Statutory or bylaw requirements for signed or paper resolutions and dispute audit may need identified records.

transmission_check.reason: Building management rules may require signed records for some resolutions; I cannot confirm which.

reasons: Desk needs a single negative fact, yet staff browse full loan history that reveals interests; non-membership is a clean predicate, though staleness and venue are minor-frequency.
context_purpose: Ensure a visiting borrower has no overdue or lost items before lending under a partner agreement.

norm_violation_today.reason: Titles and fine history exceed the standing check and conflict with library borrowing-confidentiality norms.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Details of which item is overdue, useful for resolving a dispute at the desk.

transmission_check.reason: The consortium chooses its own lookup practice and no law is known to require the full circulation view.

reasons: Court entrance needs only a roll check, but the summons discloses case details to guards; paper fallback is required and the court issues the summons so it fits an existing issuer.
context_purpose: Admit only people with business at the court that day and keep a security record.

norm_violation_today.reason: Showing case number, parties and cause of action to a security guard exceeds the admission check.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Guards may need ID matching and a visitor record for security, and the person's identity to be tied to the summons.

transmission_check.reason: Court security procedures may require ID and visitor logging; I cannot confirm specific rules.
